preconditions.description: The input must be a string.
The name must be at least one letter long.

postconditions.description: The output matrix must be a perfect square.

postconditions.expression: all(len(row) == len(stdout) for row in stdout)
postconditions.description: Each row in the matrix must have the same length as the number of rows.

postconditions.expression: all(c in name or c == '.' for row in stdout for c in row)
postconditions.description: Each character in the matrix must be a character from the name or a period.
